purpose: Independent symbol replication of the exact Round 9 RANK_REVERSAL_48H definition; no threshold changes allowed.
selection_rule: At runtime select the top 40 Binance Spot USDT symbols by current 24h quote volume, excluding the 24 prior discovery symbols, the 8 reserved final-holdout symbols, stable/fiat-like bases, and leveraged-token suffixes. BTCUSDT is used only as market-regime context.

signal.residual: asset 48h return minus cross-sectional median 48h return
signal.btc_regime: BTC close > EMA200 and BTC 24h return > -2%
